headline: Callahan's Passage and Mooring County Flare as Northern Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the morning edition, the heavy fighting in Callahan's Passage has violently breached the line, yielding four base actions over the past two hours as Colonial forces contested Crumbling Post amid more than thirty-two hundred fresh casualties. Concurrently, Mooring County flared into sharp instability, logging eight rapid base transactions centered upon The Wind Hills, leaving Colonials holding a single redoubt against eleven Warden positions. To the east, Weathered Expanse recorded two further base shifts, leaving Wardens with four garrisons, Colonials with two, and three ruined positions abandoned in no-man's-land under punishing artillery exchanges. Strategic turnover in Linn of Mercy cooled slightly but logged five additional actions, with Colonials retaining their ten-base grip alongside a solitary neutral ruin. Across Nevish Line, strategic transfers ceased over the last two hours, yet combat remained ferocious with over twenty-one hundred casualties recorded, while Stonecradle and Marban Hollow hold their scarred ground under mounting pressure.
